//: EAS Build configuration for GlamGenius. Documented at https://docs.expo.dev/build/eas-json/

development.//: For developers running the app on a physical device with a debugger attached.

preview.//: For internal testers. Produces an installable APK you can share via a link or upload to Play Console's Internal Testing track.
preview.//environment: Resolve EXPO_PUBLIC_* from the EAS preview environment. Previously this profile relied on the inline APP_ENV alone, which set a variable but told EAS nothing about which environment to read, so EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL was resolved by CLI inference rather than by a stated choice.

production.//: For the Play Store. Produces an AAB (Android App Bundle) — the format Google requires for new listings.
production.//environment: Resolve EXPO_PUBLIC_* from the EAS production environment. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL must be set there, in the EAS dashboard, once the production backend URL actually exists - see docs/OPERATIONS.md. It is deliberately not in this file: a URL committed before the endpoint exists is a build that points at nothing. EXPO_PUBLIC_* values are public build-time configuration and are embedded in the app bundle, so no secret - and in particular no Supabase service-role key, Gemini key or Sentry backend DSN - may ever be put in an EAS environment the client reads.

production.//: Once you have a Play Console service-account JSON, drop the path here. Until then, submissions are manual (upload the AAB via the Play Console UI).
